Context: 6. T.A. for local journeys

[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part-II ]  
Local Journeys mean journeys on duty on any day beyond 8 km from the duty point at Headquarters and within the limits of suburban or other Municipalities, Notified Areas or Cantonments contiguous to the Municipality/ Corporation of the Town or City in which the duty point is located. Journeys performed within the limits of an Urban Agglomeration within which the employee's headquarter is located will also be treated as 'local journeys'. - GIO (3), SR 71.
